name: pitwall
description: Local-first multi-agent workspace for software engineering.

scripts.dist:unsigned: node scripts/prepare-release.mjs --unsigned && npm run build:voice -- --optional && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip && node scripts/write-update-manifest.mjs --unsigned
scripts.dist:release: node scripts/prepare-release.mjs && npm run build:voice && npm run build && node scripts/with-env.mjs electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never && node scripts/write-update-manifest.mjs
scripts.release: npm run dist:release && npm run release:upload
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/prepare-release.mjs --windows && npm run build && node scripts/build-windows.mjs
